name: Retrofitted-work markers
instruction: Score explicit prologue, excerpt, prior-draft, or external-story framing suggesting the text existed before this prompt.

name: Prefatory note or restated tag before the narrative begins
instruction: Check whether the text opens with a short framing line before the story proper starts -- an off-topic aside about the prompt or its accompanying image, or a title line restating the prompt's tag -- rather than beginning directly in-scene. Note presence/absence only.

name: Thread-context references
instruction: Score explicit references to the prompt board, prompt stream, other submissions, or the act of replying, apart from the fictional narrative.

name: Revision-trail disclosure
instruction: Score visible edit notes, addenda, revision counters, postscript explanations, or author comments indicating changes after the initial submission.

name: Header pointing readers to the author's own earlier post
instruction: Read the first three and last three lines for an explicit external dependency: a link or note saying this is a prologue, a part one, a continuation, or that another piece should be read first. Record 0 (self-contained), 1 (the story silently assumes prior events, introducing a world or cast as already known to the reader), or 2 (an explicit continuation header or link). Separately record whether the piece parses for a reader who has not seen the other piece.

name: No read-through pass: inconsistencies a reread would catch
instruction: Count inconsistencies that only a second reading of the writer's own text would catch: a name spelled two ways within the same piece, a tense that flips mid-paragraph, a dropped or doubled word inside a sentence, a character called by the wrong name. Report the count and whether any fall in the first 200 words. Do not score vocabulary, formatting, punctuation style, or dialect spelling.

name: Compressed submission form
instruction: Score unusually compressed, fragmentary, or submission-like formatting when it appears to reflect a narrow composition or posting window.

name: Story ends without narrative resolution (cliffhanger/mid-arc cutoff)
instruction: Check whether the piece ends before its central conflict or question is resolved -- e.g. trailing off on an open threat, an undecided action, or a scene-break mark with no follow-through -- versus reaching a clear resolution or beat. Note presence/absence only.

name: Prior-thread reaction
instruction: Score explicit language or conspicuous framing that presents the story as an alternative to an obvious, expected, or already-used response.

name: Audience-facing aftercare
instruction: Score authorial notes, word counts, feedback requests, self-assessments, or archive links appended after the story as evidence of submission-stage behavior.
